title: Bank reconciliation — deterministic accounting benchmark

evidence.fact: Bank service fee of 500 has not been recorded in the books.
Bank interest income of 1000 has not been recorded in the books.

task: Identify which items require book entries and which are bank-only reconciling items.

required_output_schema.book_entry_items: array of strings chosen from service_fee, interest_income, outstanding_checks, deposit_in_transit
required_output_schema.bank_only_items: array of strings chosen from service_fee, interest_income, outstanding_checks, deposit_in_transit
required_output_schema.journal_entries: array of objects with debit_account, credit_account, amount

human_gate.reason: Deterministic educational reconciliation case with no material professional judgment.
